fields.acceptance: The ci-install testscript's expected workflow holds a concurrency group keyed on the pull request number, falling back to the commit (github.sha) for pushes to main, whose cancel-in-progress is ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}, true only for pull_request events and never for pushes to main, and keeps the push-to-main trigger and its check steps.
fields.statement: The workflow rhiza ci install writes cancels a pull request's in-progress run when a newer push to it starts one, through a per-pull-request concurrency group with cancel-in-progress limited to pull_request events, and still checks every push to main: each push to main gets its own group keyed on its commit, since GitHub cancels a group's pending run when a newer one queues even without cancel-in-progress, and a push to main never cancels an earlier push's check, since the push check is incremental from github.event.before and a cancelled run would leave that push's changes unchecked.
